blockpops.world_creator.home.title: Collections in this world
blockpops.world_creator.home.subtitle: Figures that exist only in this world. Players win them in the claw machine.
blockpops.world_creator.home.help_body: A world collection is a set of figures made for this world alone: skins on the default figure, or your own 3D models, in a box you design. Players win them from the claw and gacha machines like any other collection. A draft stays out of the machines until you publish it. Archiving takes a collection out of the machines, while the boxes and figures players already have stay.
